raw_response:
The issuer shows moderate liquidity (current ratio 1.39) but solid leverage support from shareholders’ equity (equity covers ~47% of assets) and meaningful retained earnings. Operating profitability also appears reasonably healthy, with EBIT of 1,842M on revenue of 11,164M (~16.5% margin), supporting debt service capacity, though liquidity is not strong enough for a higher tier.  

DECISION: BBB-
